body_html:
<style>
:root {
  --bg-base: #07070a;
  --bg-card: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04);
  --bg-card-hover: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.07);
  --border-soft: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.10);
  --border-medium: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16);
  --fg-strong: #ffffff;
  --fg-mid: rgba(245, 245, 247, 0.86);
  --fg-soft: rgba(245, 245, 247, 0.64);
  --fg-dim: rgba(245, 245, 247, 0.42);
  --accent: #6d28d9;
  --accent-soft: #a78bfa;
  --glow-purple: 167, 139, 250;
}
* { box-sizing: border-box; }
html, body { margin: 0; padding: 0;
  background: radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 60% at 50% -10%, rgba(var(--glow-purple), 0.12), transparent 60%), var(--bg-base);
  color: var(--fg-mid);
  font-family: 'Avenir Next', 'Avenir', 'Nunito Sans', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, system-ui, sans-serif;
  font-feature-settings: "ss01", "cv11";
  line-height: 1.6;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
}
.mz-post-wrap { max-width: 880px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 32px 24px 80px; }
.mz-post-section { margin: 56px 0; }
.mz-post-section h2 { font-weight: 200; font-size: clamp(24px, 3vw, 32px); letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: var(--fg-strong); margin: 0 0 16px; }
.mz-post-hero { margin-top: 0; }
.mz-post-eyebrow { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.22em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--accent-soft); margin: 0 0 12px; }
.mz-post-title { font-weight: 200; font-size: clamp(34px, 4.6vw, 52px); letter-spacing: -0.025em; color: var(--fg-strong); margin: 0 0 18px; line-height: 1.05; }
.mz-post-lede { font-size: 18px; color: var(--fg-mid); margin: 0 0 8px; max-width: 64ch; }
.mz-toc { background: var(--bg-card); border: 1px solid var(--border-soft); border-radius: 14px; padding: 20px 22px; margin: 32px 0 48px; backdrop-filter: blur(28px) saturate(180%); }
.mz-toc-label { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--accent-soft); margin: 0 0 14px; }
.mz-toc-chips { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; }
.mz-toc-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 7px 13px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.72); border: 1px solid var(--border-soft); border-radius: 999px; color: var(--fg-mid); font-size: 13px; text-decoration: none; transition: transform 0.18s, background 0.18s, border-color 0.18s; }
.mz-toc-chip:hover { background: var(--bg-card-hover); transform: translateY(-1px); border-color: var(--accent-soft); color: var(--fg-strong); }
.mz-toc-chip-count { color: var(--fg-dim); font-size: 11px; }
.mz-toc-group-synthesis { font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.65; color: var(--fg-mid); padding: 12px 16px; border-left: 2px solid var(--accent); margin: 0 0 20px; }
.mz-pending-author { color: var(--fg-dim); font-style: italic; }
.mz-topic-group { margin: 64px 0; padding-top: 16px; border-top: 1px solid var(--border-soft); }
.mz-topic-group-title { font-weight: 200; font-size: clamp(22px, 2.6vw, 28px); letter-spacing: -0.015em; color: var(--fg-strong); margin: 0 0 18px; }
.mz-topic-count { color: var(--fg-dim); font-size: 0.7em; font-weight: 300; }
.mz-cite-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 18px; }
@media (min-width: 720px) { .mz-cite-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; } }
.mz-cite-card { background: var(--bg-card); border: 1px solid var(--border-soft); border-radius: 14px; padding: 22px 22px 18px; backdrop-filter: blur(28px) saturate(180%); transition: transform 0.22s, border-color 0.22s, background 0.22s; }
.mz-cite-card:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); border-color: var(--accent-soft); background: var(--bg-card-hover); }
.mz-cite-head { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; margin-bottom: 8px; }
.mz-cite-design, .mz-cite-n { font-size: 11px; padding: 3px 9px; border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(var(--glow-purple), 0.14); border: 1px solid rgba(var(--glow-purple), 0.32); color: var(--accent-soft); font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.mz-cite-title { font-weight: 500; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.35; color: var(--fg-strong); margin: 6px 0 8px; }
.mz-cite-meta { font-size: 13px; color: var(--fg-soft); margin: 0 0 10px; }
.mz-cite-fits { font-size: 13px; color: var(--fg-mid); padding: 8px 12px; background: rgba(var(--glow-purple), 0.06); border-left: 2px solid var(--accent); border-radius: 4px; margin: 8px 0 12px; }
.mz-abstract { margin: 8px 0 12px; }
.mz-abstract summary { font-size: 13px; color: var(--accent-soft); cursor: pointer; font-weight: 600; padding: 8px 0; user-select: none; }
.mz-abstract summary:hover { color: var(--fg-strong); }
.mz-abstract-label { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--accent-soft); margin: 12px 0 4px; }
.mz-abstract p { font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.65; color: var(--fg-mid); margin: 0 0 10px; }
.mz-cite-actions { display: flex; gap: 10px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-top: 10px; padding-top: 10px; border-top: 1px solid var(--border-soft); }
.mz-cite-pmid { font-size: 12px; color: var(--accent-soft); text-decoration: none; padding: 5px 11px; border: 1px solid var(--border-soft); border-radius: 999px; transition: background 0.18s, border-color 0.18s; }
.mz-cite-pmid:hover { background: var(--bg-card-hover); border-color: var(--accent-soft); }
.mz-deepdive-trigger { font: inherit; cursor: pointer; font-size: 12px; padding: 5px 13px; background: rgba(var(--glow-purple), 0.10); border: 1px solid rgba(var(--glow-purple), 0.34); border-radius: 999px; color: var(--accent-soft); transition: background 0.18s, transform 0.18s, border-color 0.18s; }
.mz-deepdive-trigger:hover { background: rgba(var(--glow-purple), 0.18); transform: translateY(-1px); border-color: var(--accent-soft); color: var(--fg-strong); }
.mz-references { font-size: 13px; color: var(--fg-soft); }
.mz-references-list { padding-left: 18px; line-height: 1.6; }
.mz-references-list li { margin-bottom: 6px; }

/* Medicolegal AI disclaimer — subtle, thin, small font, bottom of page */
.mz-ai-disclaimer { max-width: 760px; margin: 36px auto 12px; padding: 14px 18px 0; border-top: 1px solid #E9E5EE; font-family: 'Nunito Sans', 'Avenir Next', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.6; font-style: italic; font-weight: 300; letter-spacing: 0.005em; color: #6E6A7C; text-align: center; }
.mz-ai-disclaimer p { margin: 0; }
.mz-ai-disclaimer a { color: rgba(184, 90, 71, 0.85); text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 2px; text-decoration-thickness: 1px; }
.mz-ai-disclaimer a:hover, .mz-ai-disclaimer a:focus-visible { color: rgba(201, 119, 89, 0.95); }
.mz-five-papers-list { padding-left: 22px; line-height: 1.65; margin: 16px 0 0; }
.mz-five-papers-list li { margin-bottom: 18px; color: var(--fg-mid); }
.mz-five-papers-list li strong:first-of-type { color: var(--fg-strong); }
.mz-five-papers-list a { color: var(--accent); text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(167, 139, 250, 0.35); }
.mz-five-papers-list a:hover { border-bottom-color: var(--accent); }

/* Five-papers grid — full mz-cite-card anatomy + numbered pick badge */
.mz-five-papers-grid { margin: 20px 0 0; }
.mz-five-pick { border-color: rgba(var(--glow-purple), 0.28); position: relative; }
.mz-five-pick:hover { border-color: var(--accent); }
.mz-five-pick-num {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  width: 26px; height: 26px; border-radius: 50%;
  background: rgba(var(--glow-purple), 0.22);
  border: 1px solid rgba(var(--glow-purple), 0.40);
  color: var(--fg-strong); font-weight: 600; font-size: 13px;
  font-family: 'Avenir Next', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0;
  text-transform: none;
}
.mz-five-read-for {
  font-size: 13px; color: var(--fg-mid); line-height: 1.5;
  padding: 8px 12px; background: rgba(var(--glow-purple), 0.04);
  border-left: 2px solid rgba(var(--glow-purple), 0.30);
  border-radius: 4px; margin: 6px 0 10px;
}

/* Inline citation reference — unobtrusive superscript with hover/tap popout */
.mz-ref { position: relative; display: inline; font-size: 0.72em; vertical-align: super; line-height: 0; margin: 0 1px 0 2px; }
.mz-ref-link { color: var(--accent-soft); text-decoration: none; padding: 0 3px; border-radius: 3px; background: rgba(var(--glow-purple), 0.10); border: 1px solid rgba(var(--glow-purple), 0.20); font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.01em; transition: background 0.18s, border-color 0.18s, color 0.18s; }
.mz-ref-link:hover, .mz-ref-link:focus { background: rgba(var(--glow-purple), 0.22); border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--fg-strong); outline: none; }
.mz-ref-pop {
  position: absolute; bottom: calc(100% + 8px); left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%);
  min-width: 280px; max-width: 360px; width: max-content;
  padding: 12px 14px; border-radius: 10px;
  background: rgba(251,250,248,0.97);
  border: 1px solid rgba(var(--glow-purple), 0.32);
  box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45);
  color: var(--fg-mid); font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.45; font-weight: 400;
  text-align: left; letter-spacing: 0;
  opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; transition: opacity 0.18s, transform 0.18s;
  z-index: 50;
  vertical-align: baseline;
}
.mz-ref:hover .mz-ref-pop, .mz-ref:focus-within .mz-ref-pop, .mz-ref.mz-open .mz-ref-pop {
  opacity: 1; pointer-events: auto;
  transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(-2px);
}
.mz-ref-pop-title { display: block; color: var(--fg-strong); font-weight: 500; margin-bottom: 4px; line-height: 1.3; }
.mz-ref-pop-meta { display: block; color: var(--fg-dim); font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; margin-bottom: 8px; }
.mz-ref-pop-finding { display: block; color: var(--fg-mid); font-size: 12.5px; line-height: 1.5; }
@media (max-width: 720px) {
  .mz-ref-pop { left: 0; right: auto; transform: none; min-width: 240px; max-width: 92vw; }
  .mz-ref:hover .mz-ref-pop, .mz-ref:focus-within .mz-ref-pop, .mz-ref.mz-open .mz-ref-pop {
    transform: translateY(-2px);
  }
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .mz-ref-pop { transition: none; } }
.mz-shape-chart { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; margin: 16px 0 12px; }
.mz-shape-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 200px 1fr 48px; gap: 12px; align-items: center; font-size: 13px; }
.mz-shape-row-label { color: var(--fg-mid); }
.mz-shape-row-bar { height: 8px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(var(--glow-purple), 0.6) 0%, rgba(var(--glow-purple), 0.3) 100%); border-radius: 4px; width: var(--mz-bar); }
.mz-shape-row-count { text-align: right; color: var(--accent-soft); font-weight: 600; }
.mz-shape-note { font-size: 13px; color: var(--fg-soft); margin: 8px 0 0; }
/* Comprehensive Journal-Club Deep-Dive Modal — 12 sections */
.mz-jc-modal {
  width: min(820px, 94vw);
  max-height: 92vh;
  padding: 0;
  border: 1px solid rgba(var(--glow-purple), 0.32);
  border-radius: 18px;
  background: rgba(251,250,248,0.97);
  backdrop-filter: blur(40px) saturate(180%);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(40px) saturate(180%);
  color: var(--fg-mid);
  box-shadow: 0 30px 80px rgba(26,23,38,0.45);
}
.mz-jc-modal::backdrop { background: rgba(26,23,38,0.55); backdrop-filter: blur(10px); }
.mz-jc-modal-inner { padding: 32px 32px 28px; overflow-y: auto; max-height: 92vh; scroll-behavior: smooth; }
.mz-jc-close {
  position: sticky; top: 0; float: right; margin: -8px -8px 0 8px;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.72); border: 1px solid #E9E5EE;
  color: var(--fg-soft); font-size: 22px; line-height: 1; cursor: pointer;
  width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 999px;
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  transition: background 0.18s, color 0.18s, transform 0.18s; z-index: 10;
}
.mz-jc-close:hover { background: rgba(var(--glow-purple), 0.22); color: var(--fg-strong); transform: rotate(90deg); }
.mz-jc-modal-header { margin: 0 0 20px; padding-bottom: 18px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-soft); }
.mz-jc-modal-eyebrow { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.28em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--accent-soft); margin: 0 0 8px; }
.mz-jc-modal-title { font-weight: 400; font-size: clamp(20px, 2.4vw, 26px); color: var(--fg-strong); margin: 0 0 10px; line-height: 1.3; letter-spacing: -0.012em; }
.mz-jc-modal-cite { font-size: 13px; color: var(--fg-mid); margin: 0 0 4px; line-height: 1.45; }
.mz-jc-modal-meta { font-size: 12px; color: var(--fg-soft); margin: 0; letter-spacing: 0.02em; }
.mz-jc-modal-meta a { color: var(--accent-soft); text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(var(--glow-purple), 0.3); }
.mz-jc-modal-meta a:hover { color: var(--fg-strong); border-bottom-color: var(--accent); }

/* TOC navigator inside the modal */
.mz-jc-modal-toc {
  display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px;
  padding: 12px 14px; margin: 0 0 24px;
  background: rgba(var(--glow-purple), 0.06);
  border: 1px solid rgba(var(--glow-purple), 0.20);
  border-radius: 10px;
}
.mz-jc-modal-toc a {
  font-size: 11px; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 999px;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.72); border: 1px solid #E9E5EE;
  color: var(--fg-soft); text-decoration: none; letter-spacing: 0.02em;
  transition: background 0.15s, border-color 0.15s, color 0.15s;
}
.mz-jc-modal-toc a:hover { background: rgba(var(--glow-purple), 0.18); color: var(--fg-strong); border-color: var(--accent); }

/* Section anatomy */
.mz-jc-section { margin: 28px 0; padding-top: 20px; border-top: 1px solid var(--border-soft); scroll-margin-top: 24px; }
.mz-jc-section:first-of-type, .mz-jc-section-bottom-line { border-top: 0; padding-top: 0; margin-top: 0; }
.mz-jc-section h3 {
  font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--accent-soft); margin: 0 0 14px;
}
.mz-jc-section-intro {
  font-size: 13.5px !important; line-height: 1.55 !important;
  color: var(--fg-soft) !important; font-style: italic;
  padding-left: 12px; margin: -4px 0 14px !important;
  border-left: 2px solid rgba(var(--glow-purple), 0.30);
}
.mz-jc-section p { font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.65; color: var(--fg-mid); margin: 0 0 12px; }
.mz-jc-section p:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }
.mz-jc-section p strong { color: var(--fg-strong); font-weight: 600; }

/* TL;DR / Bottom-line — visually distinct */
.mz-jc-section-bottom-line { background: rgba(var(--glow-purple), 0.08); border: 1px solid rgba(var(--glow-purple), 0.28); border-radius: 12px; padding: 18px 20px; }
.mz-jc-section-bottom-line h3 { color: var(--accent); margin-bottom: 10px; }
.mz-jc-bottom { font-size: 15px !important; line-height: 1.6 !important; color: var(--fg-strong) !important; font-weight: 400; }

/* PICO definition list */
.mz-jc-pico dl { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 160px 1fr; gap: 8px 18px; margin: 0; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.55; }
.mz-jc-pico dt { color: var(--accent-soft); font-weight: 600; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; padding-top: 2px; }
.mz-jc-pico dd { margin: 0; color: var(--fg-mid); }

/* Effects definition-list */
.mz-jc-effects-dl { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 8px 16px; margin: 0; font-size: 13.5px; }
.mz-jc-effects-dl dt { color: var(--fg-soft); font-weight: 500; }
.mz-jc-effects-dl dd { margin: 0; color: var(--fg-strong); font-weight: 500; font-family: 'SF Mono', 'JetBrains Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace; }
.mz-jc-effects-interpretation { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.72); border-left: 2px solid var(--accent-soft); padding: 10px 14px; margin: 14px 0 0 !important; border-radius: 4px; }

/* Risk-of-bias domains */
.mz-jc-rob-dl { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 180px 1fr; gap: 10px 16px; margin: 0 0 14px; font-size: 13.5px; line-height: 1.5; }
.mz-jc-rob-dl dt { color: var(--accent-soft); font-weight: 600; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; padding-top: 2px; }
.mz-jc-rob-dl dd { margin: 0; color: var(--fg-mid); }
.mz-jc-limitations { font-size: 13px !important; color: var(--fg-soft) !important; padding: 10px 14px; background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.05); border-left: 2px solid rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.5); border-radius: 4px; }

/* Strengths list */
.mz-jc-strengths-list { margin: 0; padding-left: 22px; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; color: var(--fg-mid); }
.mz-jc-strengths-list li { margin-bottom: 6px; }
.mz-jc-strengths-list li::marker { color: var(--accent-soft); }

/* Verbatim abstract inside modal */
.mz-jc-abstract-body { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.025); border: 1px solid var(--border-soft); border-radius: 10px; padding: 18px 20px; font-size: 13.5px; line-height: 1.6; }
.mz-jc-abstract-label { font-size: 11px !important; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--accent-soft); margin: 12px 0 4px !important; }
.mz-jc-abstract-label:first-child { margin-top: 0 !important; }
.mz-jc-abstract-body p { font-size: 13.5px !important; line-height: 1.6 !important; margin: 0 0 8px !important; color: var(--fg-mid); }
.mz-jc-abstract-note { font-size: 11px !important; color: var(--fg-dim) !important; font-style: italic; margin-top: 8px !important; }

/* Monday-clinic takeaway */
.mz-jc-monday-take { font-size: 14.5px !important; line-height: 1.65 !important; color: var(--fg-strong) !important; padding: 14px 16px; background: rgba(var(--glow-purple), 0.06); border-left: 3px solid var(--accent); border-radius: 4px; }

/* Discussion prompts */
.mz-jc-prompts-intro { font-style: italic; color: var(--fg-soft); font-size: 13px !important; }
.mz-jc-prompts-list { margin: 12px 0 0; padding-left: 0; list-style: none; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; color: var(--fg-mid); }
.mz-jc-prompts-list li { padding: 10px 14px 10px 36px; margin-bottom: 8px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.72); border: 1px solid var(--border-soft); border-radius: 8px; position: relative; }
.mz-jc-prompts-list li::before { content: "?"; position: absolute; left: 14px; top: 10px; color: var(--accent); font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; }

/* Modal footer with close button */
.mz-jc-modal-footer { margin-top: 28px; padding-top: 18px; border-top: 1px solid var(--border-soft); display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 12px; }
.mz-jc-pubmed-link { color: var(--accent-soft); font-size: 13px; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(var(--glow-purple), 0.3); }
.mz-jc-pubmed-link:hover { color: var(--fg-strong); border-bottom-color: var(--accent); }
.mz-jc-close-btn { padding: 9px 18px; background: rgba(var(--glow-purple), 0.18); border: 1px solid var(--accent); border-radius: 999px; color: var(--fg-strong); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.18s, transform 0.18s; }
.mz-jc-close-btn:hover { background: rgba(var(--glow-purple), 0.32); transform: translateY(-1px); }

.mz-jc-empty { color: var(--fg-dim); font-style: italic; font-size: 13px; }
.mz-jc-placeholder { color: var(--fg-dim); font-style: italic; }

/* Pending-manual-review marker — visually obvious so the reader knows
 * the surgeon hasn't yet weighed in on this paper's clinical content. */
.mz-jc-pending { background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.04); border-left: 3px solid rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.55); padding-left: 14px !important; border-radius: 4px; }
.mz-jc-pending-tag {
  display: inline-block; margin-left: 10px;
  padding: 3px 8px; border-radius: 999px;
  background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.18); color: rgb(252, 211, 77);
  font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.14em;
  text-transform: uppercase; vertical-align: middle;
}
.mz-jc-pending .mz-jc-monday-take { background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.04); border-left-color: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.55); color: var(--fg-soft) !important; font-style: italic; }
.mz-jc-pending dd { color: var(--fg-soft); font-style: italic; }

/* Q&A list — answered discussion questions in journal-club deep-dive */
.mz-jc-qa-list { counter-reset: qa; list-style: none; padding-left: 0; margin: 12px 0 0; }
.mz-jc-qa-item {
  counter-increment: qa; margin-bottom: 18px;
  padding: 16px 18px 14px;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.72);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-soft); border-radius: 10px;
  position: relative;
}
.mz-jc-qa-item::before {
  content: counter(qa);
  position: absolute; top: -10px; left: 14px;
  width: 24px; height: 24px; border-radius: 999px;
  background: rgba(var(--glow-purple), 0.32); border: 1px solid var(--accent);
  color: var(--fg-strong); font-weight: 700; font-size: 12px;

<summary>Read the full abstract</summary>
<p>Comment in CMAJ. 198:E707.</p>
<p><strong>Background.</strong> Maternal chronic conditions are implicated as risk factors for congenital anomalies, but few studies have assessed reproductive conditions such as endometriosis. Given the association between endometriosis and infertility requiring fertility treatments, we sought to estimate risks of congenital anomalies in infants of patients with endometriosis and mediation by subfertility and fertility treatments. METHODS: We conducted a population-based study of births in Ontario (Apr. 7, 2006, to Mar. 31, 2021) to identify infants born at 20 weeks' gestation or later to patients aged 15 to 50 years. We analyzed associations of endometriosis in the patient before conception with congenital anomalies in their infant. We determined the proportion of these associations mediated by subfertility, ovulation induction or intrauterine insemination, and in vitro fertilization or intracytoplasmic sperm injection. RESULTS: Among 1 460 564 eligible births, 33 619 (2.3%) patients had endometriosis. Congenital anomalies occurred in 2120 (6.3%) infants of patients with endometriosis and 77 094 (5.4%) infants of patients without endometriosis. Endometriosis in the patient was independently associated with a higher risk of any congenital anomaly (adjusted relative risk [RR] 1.16, 95% confidence interval [CI] 1.12 to 1.21). Specific anomalies with the highest associated risks included unspecified cleft palate (adjusted RR 1.52, 95% CI 1.03 to 2.25), hypospadias (adjusted RR 1.47, 95% CI 1.04 to 2.09), and pulmonary artery stenosis (adjusted RR 1.41, 95% CI 1.03 to 1.94). Endometriosis was an independent risk factor for any congenital anomaly, with only 11.0% of the associated risk mediated by in vitro fertilization or intracytoplasmic injection; subfertility, ovulation induction, and intrauterine insemination did not mediate the association between endometriosis and anomalies. INTERPRETATION: Endometriosis in the patient is associated with small but significantly increased risks of congenital anomalies among offspring, partially mediated by fertility treatment. The potential mechanisms remain to be identified.</p>
